sectionTitle: The Anatomy of a Couture Canvas
sectionSubtitle: Deconstruct a royal Banarasi couture illustration across its 4 foundational Procreate layers — from gesture croquis to 24k zardozi glaze.

layers.name: 01. The 9-Head Runway Croquis
layers.description: Elongated 9-head haute couture gesture lines defining shoulder tilt, hip cant, and fabric flow lines.
layers.techniqueTip: Keep wrist loose and draw from the shoulder for unbroken, dynamic garment curves.

layers.name: 02. Underpainting & Gouache Wash
layers.description: Warm drystone clay and amber undertones mapped across facial planes and silk drape understructures.
layers.techniqueTip: Establish the primary light source angle before laying down saturated pigment.

layers.name: 03. Velvet Drapery & Chiaroscuro
layers.description: Deep obsidian and cindered red shadow recesses giving heavy royal textile folds tactile weight.
layers.techniqueTip: Use soft blending stumps on outer drapery bends and razor edges in deep fold crevasses.

layers.name: 04. 24k Zardozi Embroidery & Glaze
layers.brush: Pure Gold Leaf Flake & Polki Facet
layers.description: Hand-rendered pure gold metallic thread embroidery, gemstone specular highlights, and luminous fabric gleam.
layers.techniqueTip: Concentrate specular highlights strictly at the apex of curves where studio light hits perpendicularly.
